name: nexus-ai-pro
description: Typed AI framework for TypeScript: provider routing and failover, durable agent graphs and workflows, retrieval over any vector store, MCP, evals, guardrails, and cost control

scripts.clean: node --eval "for (const dir of ['dist', 'dist-cjs']) require('node:fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.docs:guides: node scripts/check-guide-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-doc-imports.mjs && node scripts/root-migration.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:conformance:mock && npm run test:conformance:images && npm run size:check && npm run docs:check && npm run docs:guides && npm run test:studio && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:api && npm run test:types
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run registry:check && npm run llms:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run studio:typecheck && npm run typecheck:examples && npm run typecheck:examples:browser && npm run test:coverage
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run bench:graph && npm run pack:dry-run && npm run test:clean-install && npm run test:studio-install
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --removeComments --declaration false && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/finalize-cjs.mjs

author: Mkhitar Abrahamyan <mkhitar.abrahamyan99@gmail.com>
